fact: The terms of reference state the national revenue directorate runs a Revenue Management System (GRE) for internal taxes, ASYCUDA for customs and SIGOF for the state budget, and commission a Tax and Customs information system architecture and interoperability model.
title: Consultancy Services to define a Tax and Customs information system architecture and conceptual Interoperability model definition
publisher: Ministério das Finanças e do Fomento Empresarial (Cabo Verde)
